name: Slate Bristle
tagline: The command layer for the crews that keep the built world spotless.
positioning: Slate Bristle turns janitorial chaos — scattered checklists, no-show subs, disputed invoices — into one disciplined operation for owner-operators.

hero.h1: Run a cleaning empire from one screen.
hero.sub: Slate Bristle unifies scheduling, crew tracking, digital checklists, and billing so owner-operators can scale from three accounts to three hundred without losing a single square foot.

features.title: Site-perfect scheduling
features.description: Assign crews to routes, lock in recurring floor-strip cycles, and get pinged the moment a shift risks a no-show — before your client ever notices.

features.title: Proof-of-clean checklists
features.description: Every restroom, dock, and stairwell gets a timestamped checklist with before-and-after photos your building manager can actually audit.

features.title: Invoices that close themselves
features.description: Completed jobs roll straight into itemized invoices, so the Friday-night billing marathon becomes a two-minute review.

features.title: Live crew visibility
features.description: See who clocked in at which facility on one map — no more calling three supervisors to find out if the third-shift team showed.

features.title: Supply burn tracking
features.description: Track degreaser, liners, and pads by account so you stop eating margin on the jobs that quietly drain your storeroom.

features.title: Compliance on autopilot
features.description: OSHA training logs, SDS sheets, and insurance certs stay current and one export away when a client demands them.

testimonials.quote: We went from four office whiteboards to one dashboard. Slate Bristle caught two missed night crews in the first week and paid for itself before payroll ran.
testimonials.name: Marcus Delgado

testimonials.quote: My clients used to dispute invoices constantly. Now every line item ships with photo proof. Disputes basically stopped, and we won two new hospital contracts on it.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkatesh

testimonials.quote: I run 40 buildings with a lean office. The supply-burn reports alone recovered about nine grand a quarter I didn't know I was leaking.
testimonials.name: Danielle Okafor

pricing.blurb: For the solo owner-operator running a handful of steady accounts.
For growing companies coordinating multiple shifts and supervisors.
For multi-region operators with procurement and audit demands.

homepage.footerBlurb: Slate Bristle is the operating layer for ambitious cleaning companies — turning grit and hustle into a business that runs like clockwork.
